LaunchOS v0.3: adds a **Browser** and a **Setup** app, and makes the home screen and side menu real.

- Browser with a start page and shortcuts. Connects to the internet over VirtualBox's NAT network.
- Setup: name and color, time zone, network check, sound, screen size, controller test, look, app picks.
- Settings that work: volume, screen size (with a TV safe area), network status and test, time zone, about, power.
- Sound and video support, network time.

Download **LaunchOS.zip**, unzip it, then in VirtualBox choose **Machine > Add** and pick **LaunchOS.vbox**. Check the version in Settings > About LaunchOS.
